report.summary: An incorrect routing configuration change applied to upi-gateway redirected @okbank handles to an invalid /v3/collect endpoint on partner-bank-api, causing 404 Not Found errors, U30 route failure errors in payments-api, and an 8-10% failure rate in UPI payments.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Incorrect routing configuration update in upi-gateway

supporting.note: Routing table change moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect at 14:06, immediately preceding the anomaly.
Error rate spiked sharply at 14:07, right after the config change.
upi-gateway logged partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect returning 404 Not Found starting at 14:07.
payments-api logged UPI collect failures due to upi-gateway error U30 (route failure) starting at 14:07.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Code deployment in payments-api (v2.15.0) introduced transaction failures

supporting.note: payments-api v2.15.0 was deployed at 14:05, just before the incident.

contradicting.note: Logs show payments-api failed specifically because of upi-gateway error U30, not an internal application error from the new version.
Root cause originates downstream in upi-gateway calling partner-bank-api, which is independent of payments-api v2.15.0.

facts.text: payments-api error rate metric showed an upward anomaly starting at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, peaking at 8.89%.
upi-gateway error rate metric showed an upward anomaly starting at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, peaking at 10.28%.
upi-gateway routing config update moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect at 2026-10-07T14:06:00+00:00.
upi-gateway logged partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect returning 404 Not Found for @okbank handles starting at 2026-10-07T14:07:03+00:00.
payments-api logged UPI collect failures with upi-gateway error U30 (route failure) starting at 2026-10-07T14:07:07+00:00.

assumptions: @okbank users account for approximately 8% of total payment volume, aligning with the observed 8% customer impact and failure rate.
The partner-bank-api does not implement or support the /v3/collect endpoint for these handles.
evidence_gaps: Direct API access logs from external vendor partner-bank-api are unavailable.

timeline.event: upi-gateway routing config updated for @okbank handles to use /v3/collect
Error rate anomaly started on payments-api and upi-gateway
upi-gateway began logging 404 Not Found errors from partner-bank-api
payments-api began logging U30 route failure errors

recommended_actions.action: Roll back the upi-gateway routing configuration update to restore @okbank handle routing to /v2/collect.
recommended_actions.rationale: The config change directly introduced the 404 Not Found errors and resulting payment failures.

recommended_actions.action: Confirm endpoint contracts and support with partner-bank-api before attempting to migrate handles to /v3/collect in the future.
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures the external vendor supports the requested URI path before configuration is applied in production.

recommended_actions.action: Implement automated validation checks in the routing configuration pipeline to verify upstream endpoint availability.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents similar configuration errors from reaching production unvalidated.
